confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, hotel listings or booking pages. Food and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because rates vary by district and booking window. Draft beer is uncommon in Lima restaurants, so the beer anchor is a proxy for typical domestic servings. Cocktail (about 2.1x the beer anchor) and wine glass (about 1.7x) are general-knowledge estimates cross-checked against the beer relationship.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Latin American capital-city pricing. Lima's inexpensive food and hostel levels are broadly in line with Bogota and Mexico City. Hotel anchors reflect Lima's business and tourist hotel stock rather than cheaper Peruvian regional cities. Model-based; no comparable-city listings were searched.
